title: Internet Outage Detection and Log
dataSources: UniFi controller events (`unifi:event`), Pi-hole query log (`pihole:query`), AdGuard Home (`adguard:query`), speedtest-cli results (`speedtest:result`), router/firewall syslog.
app: UniFi / router syslog, Pi-hole/AdGuard, and scheduled speedtests via HEC scripted inputs and the Universal Forwarder.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=uptime:probe target=internet
| sort 0 _time
| streamstats current=f last(status) as prev_status
| where status="down" AND prev_status="up"
| table _time status
| sort - _time
description: Records every moment your internet connection drops so you have a dated outage log to raise with your provider.
value: Providers ask 'when exactly?' — an automatic outage log answers with timestamps and turns anecdotes into a credible complaint.
implementation: Probe an external target continuously and forward results; schedule frequently and alert on transitions to down.
visualization: Timeline of outages with start times and durations.
grandmaExplanation: It keeps a dated list of every time your internet went down, which is exactly what your provider asks for.
